channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Digital Content Open Call
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Flat honorarium of USD 2,500 to 5,000 per selected proposal, at the Museum's discretion

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Programmatic Open Call (public programs)
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 1,000 total per selected program, covering all costs including speaker and performer fees, travel, materials and equipment rental; proposals using external funding or smaller budgets welcome. The Museum sets ticket prices and keeps ticket revenue. No application fee.

item.title: Movies that Matter Festival 2027: Film Submissions
item.description: Movies that Matter · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Cash prizes: EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Documentary award (winner also becomes eligible for consideration for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature), EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Fiction award, and EUR 1,500 Shorts award; further competitions (Activist Lens, Justice Frame, Dutch Focus, Education Award, Audience Award) publish no amounts. SUBMISSION FEE: EUR 25 until 30 September 2026, EUR 35 late fee 1 October to 1 November 2026; fee waivers only in very exceptional cases.

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 November 2026 Cut-Off)
item.description: The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

item.title: Playful Obscura 2027: Arthouse Games Residency Africa (Addis Ababa, Goethe-Institut and A MAZE.)
item.description: Goethe-Institut Addis Abeba, with Creative HUB Ethiopia, A MAZE., British Council and Alliance Ethio-Francaise · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Three-week funded residency hosting two artists at a time. 2027 financial terms were not published in the call excerpt we could verify; the 2026 Accra edition provided accommodation, a production budget of up to EUR 1,000 and a EUR 300 stipend. No application fee.

item.title: American Academy in Rome: Rome Prize Fellowship 2027-28
item.description: American Academy in Rome · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipends of USD 16,000 (half-term, about 5 months) and USD 30,000 (full-term, about 10 months), plus housing, workspace and weekday meals. Approximately 30 fellowships per year. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 by 1 November (USD 60 for multiple categories); USD 80/90 in the late window to 15 November.

item.title: Shape Arts: Emergent Residency 2026/27 (Tate St Ives / Porthmeor Studios)
item.description: Shape Arts, with Tate St Ives · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 3,000 bursary for the selected residency artist (restricted to artists living or working in Cornwall, Devon or Somerset). Disabled artists in the rest of the UK can join the shortlisted cohort, which brings mentoring and profile but no stated bursary. No application fee.

item.title: The Photographers' Gallery: Future of Archives, Whose Archive is it Anyway? (Call for Speakers)
item.description: The Photographers' Gallery · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 200 speaker fee for each selected speaker. No application fee.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: EMMA Kreativzentrum Pforzheim: Designers in Residence 2027 (EUR 1,000/month, 3 months)
item.description: EMMA Kreativzentrum Pforzheim (City of Pforzheim), with Pforzheim University and Design Center Baden-Wuerttemberg · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month (EUR 3,000 over the residency), plus material costs covered, free accommodation and reimbursed travel. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: HIAP: Ukraine Solidarity Residencies Programme 2027 (Finland)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme) and partner residencies · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,200 per month (EUR 1,200 to 3,600 depending on residency length), plus free living and working space, one return trip from the artist's home, and a small access budget for disabled artists. No application fee.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: Kunstpunt Groningen: Open Call Tschumi Pavilion (Hellend Vlak 2027)
item.description: Kunstpunt Groningen · deadline 04 Nov 2026 · Up to three shortlisted artists receive EUR 1,500 (excl. VAT) each for a preliminary design; the selected artist receives a EUR 17,000 project budget, including their fee. No application fee.

item.title: VIA Art Fund: Artistic Production Grant (Spring 2027 cycle)
item.description: VIA Art Fund · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · $25,000 to $100,000 per project

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)
item.description: Harry Ransom Center, The University of Texas at Austin · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Postdoctoral Fellowships: USD 3,500 per month for one or two months. Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: Realities in Transition RiT2 Open Call #3: Uncharted Grounds, a VRChat world residency with L.E.V. Festival (EUR 10,000 fee plus up to EUR 15,000 production)
item.description: Realities in Transition (RiT2, Creative Europe), with L.E.V. Festival · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 gross artist fee per selected artist (paid in three instalments) plus up to EUR 15,000 gross production budget shared among the team. No travel or accommodation included. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Netherlands Film Production Incentive: High-End Series (October 2026 round)
item.description: Netherlands Film Fund (Nederlands Filmfonds) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Cash rebate of up to 35 percent of qualifying Dutch production costs, capped at EUR 3 million per project per year per applicant production company. The 2026 annual budget is EUR 9.5 million across three rounds, plus an additional EUR 0.4 million in the first round carried over from 2025. No application fee.

item.title: Propuestas VEGAP 2026: XXX Call for Visual Creation Grants
item.description: VEGAP (Visual Entidad de Gestion de Artistas Plasticos), Fondo Asistencial y Cultural · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 100,000 total: 20 grants of EUR 5,000 each. No application fee.

item.title: City of Timisoara Project Centre: Mobilities for Cultural Professionals 2026
item.description: Centrul de Proiecte al Municipiului Timisoara · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Maximum RON 7,500 per national mobility; maximum RON 10,000 per international mobility. Non-reimbursable, with a required co-funding of at least 1% of the project budget. No application fee.

item.title: Ernest Albert Invitational 2027: Artistic Development Residency at Cas-co x Kunsthal Mechelen
item.description: Cas-co, Leuven and Kunsthal Mechelen · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · EUR 6,080 total including VAT: an artist fee of EUR 1,100 per month, a transportation allowance of EUR 120 per month, and a one-time production budget of EUR 1,200. Kunsthal Mechelen provides additional artist and production fees for the exhibition. No application fee.

item.title: Burning Man: BRC Honoraria Art Grants 2027 (Letter of Intent)
item.description: Burning Man Project · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · USD 1.5 million annual art-grant budget across approximately 75 projects; grants fund 40 to 60% of the proposed total budget, and the official page notes grants over USD 20,000 are rare. No fixed per-award figure is published. No application fee.

item.title: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans 2027 (US graduate study)
item.description: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · Up to USD 90,000 over two years (stipend and tuition support) toward graduate study; 30 fellowships awarded annually. No application fee.

item.title: Fondation Vocatio: Bourse Vocatio 2027 (EUR 10,000 for young talents in Belgium)
item.description: Fondation Vocatio · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 bourse per laureate, funding a concrete personal project (equipment, production, training). No application fee.

item.title: AFTER THE PALACE: Resonance 2026 Video Mapping Contest (Krakow)
item.description: University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (unLoc project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Cash prizes: PLN 10,000 (~EUR 2,340) first place, PLN 6,000 second, PLN 3,000 third; the jury may award additional honorary distinctions or redistribute the pool. Free to enter, submission is exclusively digital.

item.title: Art Explora x Cité internationale des arts Residency, 7th Call (Paris)
item.description: Art Explora Foundation and Cité internationale des arts · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month living stipend plus up to EUR 3,000 production grant, a furnished live-work studio of around 50 m2 at the Cité internationale des arts, round-trip travel to Paris and curatorial mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: LA Department of Cultural Affairs: NEAR + CO-UP Artist Residency Grants 2027-28
item.description: City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · NEAR grants of USD 12,000 for individual artists; CO-UP grants of USD 15,000 for collaborations between social-justice nonprofits and artists. No application fee.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.

item.title: 4th Matsu Biennial International Open Call (Matsu Islands, Taiwan)
item.description: Matsu Biennial Promotion Committee (Lienchiang County Government and General Association of Chinese Culture) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · 4 to 5 proposals are selected; each in principle receives NTD 800,000 (approximately USD 25,000, tax included) in financial support.

item.title: Transatlantic Stars Visual Arts Program 2027: US residencies for EU artists
item.description: European Union Delegation to the United States · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Fully funded: each selected artist receives a living stipend and a materials budget (amounts not published), plus airfare, visa assistance, on-site lodging, studio space and access to host facilities. Six placements. Free to apply.

item.title: First Flights Short Film Fund (Autumn 2026 Round)
item.description: First Flights Media Limited, with Kodak and Periscope · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Up to GBP 7,000 / USD 10,000 cash toward production; plus two Kodak awards of 5 x 400ft rolls of 16mm stock with full processing, and one USD 10,000 Periscope post-production package

item.title: Frame Contemporary Art Finland: Mobility and Production Grants (October 2026 round)
item.description: Frame Contemporary Art Finland · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Mobility grants EUR 250 to 5,000; production grants EUR 2,500 to 8,000. No application fee.

item.title: Stichting Stokroos: Seed Grant, Autumn 2026 round
item.description: Stichting Stokroos · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for individuals, EUR 7,500 for duos, EUR 10,000 for collectives, as an unrestricted contribution to a self-defined plan. No application fee.

item.title: Schlossmediale Call for Art Residency 2027 (Schloss Werdenberg, Switzerland)
item.description: Schlossmediale Werdenberg · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CHF 4,000 grant per resident, plus CHF 1,000 for travel, transport and meals, up to CHF 1,000 for material costs, and accommodation in a shared house (individual rooms). Three residencies awarded.

item.title: Struts Gallery: Open Studio Residency Program 2027 (Sackville, New Brunswick)
item.description: Struts Gallery · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · CAD 3,250 artist fee, CAD 30 per diem (CAD 750 total for 25 working days), travel costs up to CAD 800, and CAD 200 towards materials for workshops or other public events. Residents also get 24-hour access to a roughly 400 sq ft studio, a private furnished two-bedroom apartment above the gallery, and access to the centre's media arts equipment and facilities.

item.title: National Parks Arts Foundation: Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park Residency, October 2027 (All Media)
item.description: National Parks Arts Foundation (NPAF) · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · USD 4,000 stipend, plus a month's housing in a three-bedroom house with recording booth, meditation area and art-studio conversion, about 30 minutes from park headquarters. Travel and required insurance are the artist's own responsibility. APPLICATION FEE: USD 60 single artist, USD 120 couple or duo, USD 160 group of 3 or more.

item.title: Creative Industries Fund NL: Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
item.description: Creative Industries Fund NL (Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie), with Videotage · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · One residency grant: EUR 5,000 for a two-month work period or EUR 6,500 for three months, covering travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Housing, work space, Videotage guidance and production costs are paid by the Fund directly to Videotage on top of the grant; accommodation is arranged by Videotage. No application fee.

item.title: Perform Europe: Open Call 2026-2028 (cross-border touring)
item.description: Perform Europe (co-funded by Creative Europe, European Union) · deadline 22 Oct 2026 · Three grant tiers: EUR 15,000 (small), EUR 25,000 (medium) or EUR 55,000 (large) per proposal, plus top-ups of up to EUR 5,000 for sustainability and accessibility needs; absolute maximum EUR 60,000 per proposal including top-ups. No application fee.

item.title: Screen Australia First Nations Documentary Development (up to AUD 30,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 22 Oct 2026 · Up to AUD 30,000 for feature and series documentaries intended for commissioning platforms; up to AUD 20,000 for one-hour television documentaries and for online series. Provided as a grant.

item.title: Screen Australia First Nations Feature Development (up to AUD 45,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 22 Oct 2026 · Up to AUD 30,000, or up to AUD 45,000 with a producer attached, covering screenplay development including fees for writer, producer, director and story consultant where appropriate.

item.title: Screen Australia First Nations TV Drama Development (up to AUD 65,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 22 Oct 2026 · Up to AUD 30,000 for one-off projects (AUD 45,000 with a producer attached) and up to AUD 65,000 for series, other than in exceptional circumstances. Provided as a grant.

item.title: 2027 ACC NEXT Emerging Asian Artists International Open Call (Gwangju)
item.description: National Asian Culture Center (ACC) · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Artist fee of KRW 3,000,000 per work, an installation and materials budget of up to KRW 2,000,000 per work, one round-trip international airfare (or domestic transportation), and tentative accommodation at Asia Plex Studio. One artist or team is additionally selected for the 2027 ACC CREATORS Residency through an artist pitch review. For teams, fees, travel and accommodation go to the team leader only.

item.title: The Center Fellowship for Justice-Impacted Artists (Center for Art & Advocacy, US)
item.description: The Center for Art & Advocacy · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 in unrestricted funds plus USD 10,000 in project development funds per fellow, awarded annually.

item.title: Culture Push: Black Utopian Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Climate Justice Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Disability Arts + Dreaming Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, a Thought Partner, mentors in the field, and access check-ins, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Fellowship for Utopian Practice 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, feedback and mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: LOEWE FOUNDATION: Craft Prize 2027
item.description: LOEWE FOUNDATION · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 50,000 for the winning entry. No application fee.

item.title: Pedantic Arts Residency and Research Grant 2027 (Pittsburgh)
item.description: Pedantic Arts Residency · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Residency: free furnished housing in a shared apartment plus a USD 2,000 living stipend (half on arrival, half on completion). Research Grant: a free private bedroom at the Pedantic Apartment plus a USD 500 or USD 1,000 honorarium at the grantee's discretion. Application free until 28 September 2026, then USD 20.

item.title: The Elephant Trust: Autumn 2026 Grant Round (UK)
item.description: The Elephant Trust · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · Grants to visual artists of up to GBP 5,000; typical awards range GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000. Projects with a total budget exceeding GBP 30,000 are not supported. No application fee.

item.title: La Nueva Fabrica Residency 2027-2028 (Antigua, Guatemala)
item.description: La Nueva Fabrica (LNF) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend, plus free housing in an equipped on-site house, airport transfers, curatorial and logistical support, and access to community programming. Five residents selected annually. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Convergences Video Prize, 6th edition (short films on mental illness)
item.description: Arts Convergences, in partnership with Thanks for Nothing · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 total: Grand Prize EUR 2,000, Jury Prize EUR 1,500, Public Choice Prize EUR 1,500 (online vote). Additional prizes may be awarded. No entry fee.

item.title: La Biennale di Venezia: Biennale College Blend, 2nd edition (EUR 20,000 award)
item.description: La Biennale di Venezia · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · One Biennale College Blend Award of EUR 20,000 to the most compellingly structured project. Accommodation covered for the Venice workshop (travel not covered). No application fee.
